objectives.name: the archive
objectives.text: Follow the Host up to the top floors

objectives.name: the penthouse
objectives.text: Get through the archive and up to the penthouse

radio.line: Rifles on the tanks. Stay low, keep moving, you're nearly there.
Top floors, then the roof. There's a bridge across to the tower up there. If they're moving her, that's how.
Folks, small update. I'm bleeding a bit. Show goes on.
Folks, small update. He's still coming. Show goes on.
Careful in here! Twenty years of my best work. Don't you touch it.
Prepare the transfer. Nobody crosses that bridge after her.
Parker. I see her. On the bridge. Go!
No, you don't. Listen. They're taking me up to the studio, he wants you watching when—
Take her across. Blow the bridge.
The scaffold! Come up the outside, they never watch the outside!
Ooh. Sorry, folks. Bit of a technical problem there. Stay with us.

headshot.line: Not near the tapes! Not near the tapes!
Ah! Right in front of the archive. Show some respect.

bail.line: Mind the tapes! Those are originals!
Ha! Down he goes, among the classics.
Careful! That shelf's older than you.

combo.line: He's running across my whole back catalogue! Do you know how long that took me?
Ugh. Fine. Somebody record that, I'll use it later.

fall.line: Whoops. Long way down. Trust me, I'd know.
Fell. Back up, she's right there.
Over the edge! Oh, that's going in the archive.

kill.line: That's one of the Ward's. The Commander's gonna write me a letter.
That one alphabetised the tapes! Do you know how rare that is?
Another one gone. I'm running out of staff, Parker. Honestly.

down.line: Get up. She's right above you.
He's down! Hang on, let me find a window.
He's down in the archive! Filed under 'gone'.
Up. Don't let them pin you in the stacks.
Ooh, down he goes. Echo, sweetheart, you might want to look away.

tape.line: ...if he moves me to the tower, it'll be the top floor. The studio. I'll leave the vents open.
...the first show he ever did is on a shelf in here somewhere. He sounded scared. I've heard it.
...there's a bridge off the roof, straight into the tower. If I'm not here when you get here, that's where they've taken me.
